content:
The video racing across Facebook is real. Father Patricio Alfredo Sánchez Molinari, 53, parish priest of Our Lady of Perpetual Help Church — Perpetuo Socorro — in Guayaquil, Ecuador, died Saturday, October 17, after a large wooden crucifix detached from the wall behind the altar and fell on him during an evening Mass that was being livestreamed online.

According to CNN and USA TODAY, which reviewed the livestream footage, the crucifix came loose about 27 minutes into the service, while Father Sánchez faced the congregation from the altar. It struck the back of his head. Parishioners screamed, several rushed to his side, and voices on the broadcast can be heard calling for an ambulance. He died from his injuries.

The Archdiocese of Guayaquil confirmed his death, saying he "has departed to the House of the Father to enjoy his presence and glory." On Sunday the church held a memorial Eucharist led by Cardinal Luis Cabrera, the archbishop of Guayaquil, who thanked people around the world for their condolences and prayers. Ecuadorian broadcaster Ecuavisa reported that Father Sánchez was also preparing to lead a wedding ceremony that evening.

Father Sánchez belonged to the Congregation of the Most Holy Redeemer — the Redemptorists — and had previously served as a parish priest in Vinces, in Los Ríos Province, before Guayaquil. Minutes before the accident, his homily had been about the fleeting nature of life and the quality of time people give to God and family — words that have since been quoted around the world.

What is not yet known — and a rumor Webb Watch checked

No official finding has explained why the crucifix fell. Police have not commented publicly, and as of Sunday the church had given no account of whether a mounting failure or structural problem was involved. Webb Watch will follow any official report.

Some viral posts have also claimed Father Sánchez stole $2 million in church donations. Webb Watch found no police report, court record, or credible news report supporting that claim — it appears nowhere in the coverage by CNN, USA TODAY, or Ecuadorian media. Treat it as unproven.

Sources:

  • CNN
  • USA TODAY
  • People en Español
  • CNN en Español

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, Webb Watch 956

title: Verified: Priest Killed by Falling Crucifix During Livestreamed Mass in Ecuador
